items.title: For a representable morphism, quasi-separatedness is equivalent to the diagonal being quasi-compact and quasi-separated
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces is quasi-separated exactly when its diagonal is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (author lemma at source lines 498-507, label lemma-representable-quasi-separated-diagonal-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 509-543) presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, transports the property of the diagonal by the base change formula and the covering criterion, applies the corresponding equivalence for algebraic spaces and returns to the stack (proof lines 509-542). The reduction through the presentation is the substance. H3.
